# Rosalind Penrose

## Overview

- **Age:** 45 years old (when introduced)  <sub>[v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044), [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c3 P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030)</sub>

## Appearance

Rosalind is a tiny woman with snow-white hair that is wavy, thick, and set in flattering puffs and coils. Beneath her white hair, she retains an almost youthful face with rosy cheeks, dimples, sweet lips, and large, gentle wood-brown eyes with flecks of gold. Her voice brings to mind white satin, splashing water, and fairy bells.

_Sources: [v2 c13 P60](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0060), [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 c22 P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002)_

## Personality

Imaginative, romantic, and deeply youthful in spirit, Rosalind loves to play pretend and detests admitting her advancing age. Although she had long withdrawn from social life into a quiet world of dreams, she is hospitably warm and welcoming to kindred spirits. Despite her romantic and dreamy nature, she can also show a practical side in managing her household.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 c22 P7](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0007), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c23 P29](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0029)_

## Traits

- Highly imaginative  <sub>[v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 c21 P74](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0074)</sub>
- Hates acknowledging her age  <sub>[v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009)</sub>
- Hospitable  <sub>[v2 c21 P58](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0058), [v2 c21 P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064)</sub>
- Fond of young girls  <sub>[v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062)</sub>
- Dislikes host visits out of family duty  <sub>[v2 c27 P48](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0048)</sub>
- Dislikes dahlias

## Abilities

- Cooking and confectionery making  <sub>[v2 c21 P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- Gardening  <sub>[v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022)</sub>

## Goals

- To remain youthful in heart and mind through imaginative play  <sub>[v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009)</sub>

## History

Living quietly at Echo Cottage in Welby, Rosalind led a solitary, romantic life filled with dreams and local echoes, assisted by her young handmaiden Belinda the Fourth. When Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke stumbled upon her stone house, they quickly formed a warm friendship, and Nell became a regular visitor. Overcoming her initial hesitation, Rosalind agreed to meet Cedric Stanhope, the son of her former fiancé Stephen Stanhope, and grew deeply fond of him. After Stephen returned to the region and sent word through Nell, he visited Rosalind at Echo Cottage, resolving their past rift. The two were married late that August beneath the honeysuckle trellis in her garden before departing for Boston and the Pacific coast. They continue to reside in Boston while returning every summer to inhabit Echo Cottage.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c23 P25](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0025), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c28 P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 c28 P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064), [v2 c30 P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 c30 P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033), [v3 c1 P2](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0002), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v3 c23 P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v3 c23 P2](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0002), [v4 c3 P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of old Mr. Penrose, an English immigrant who built Echo Cottage  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086), [v2 c22 P7](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0007)</sub>
- Named Rosalind after her father's love for the lavender-scented sheets in her mother's family home  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- Was betrothed in her youth to Stephen Stanhope before a disagreement broke their engagement  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c21 P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009)</sub>
- Her mother passed away ten years prior to Nell's visit  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Employed a succession of handmaidens whom she universally nicknamed 'Belinda'  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes

> Young girls are dear to me. Pretending to be a girl myself comes so naturally when I am in their company. I really despise accepting that I am advanced in years.  <sub>[v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062)</sub>

> I always prefer to execute things as thoroughly as I can, and because it was my fate to become an old maid, I resolved that I would be an exceptionally pleasant one.  <sub>[v2 c23 P15](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0015)</sub>

> Oh, at times, it seems to me that making friends serves no purpose. After a bit, they merely depart from your life, leaving behind an ache that exceeds the void existing before their arrival.  <sub>[v2 c27 P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032)</sub>
